title: Ex-Google Recruiter Explains: Why You Get Ghosted After “Great” Interviews

In this video, I break down 8 things you should NEVER say in a job interview, and exactly what to say instead. These are subtle, high-stakes mistakes that quietly sabotage even the most experienced candidates. If you've ever walked out of an interview feeling great... and still got ghosted, this is why.

You'll learn:

How to keep leverage without sounding desperate

What interviewers are really hearing (even when you're being honest)

The framing shifts that make your answers actually work for you

After years recruiting for companies like Google, Lyft, Uber, TikTok, and The New York Times, I've seen firsthand how smart people lose offers, not because they lack experience, but because of how they communicate under pressure.

By the end of this video, you’ll know how to stay in control, protect your value, and land more offers.
